title: Clamp with parameters
prompt: Return value, but never lower than low and never higher than high. Godot has a built-in function for exactly this.
signature: func solve(value: int, low: int, high: int) -> int:
starter:
func solve(value: int, low: int, high: int) -> int:
	return value
hint: The built-in is called clamp and takes three parameters, in the same order as yours.
solution:
func solve(value: int, low: int, high: int) -> int:
	return clamp(value, low, high)
